## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete problem and how this patch changes it. Link an issue if one exists.

## Evidence

List the commands/results and relevant CI artifacts. Separate ordinary checking,
BendTT, runtime/backend tests, host loading and recommendations; record skips.

- [ ] Existing laws and independent output oracles are preserved, or each intentional specification change is explained and reviewed.
- [ ] Added examples have relevant boundary inputs and independently established expected behavior; proof changes retain targeted negative/mutation checks.
- [ ] Source/version pins, attribution and compatibility notes match the change.
- [ ] Relevant structure, unit, full-suite and kernel checks ran; unavailable checks are explicitly identified.

Mark items N/A with a reason where they do not apply. Publishing releases or
changing repository settings requires a separate maintainer decision.
